svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Know it or look it up
svg.desc: Flowchart: start with your question. If the answer could have changed since the training cutoff, go on; otherwise the model can answer from training, but check anything that sounds like common knowledge. If it needs many sources compared, use deep research; otherwise use web search.

g.text: Know it or look it up
Two questions decide where the answer should come from.
one fresh fact, check the source
